title: Alternating affine resolution with invertible ordinary exchange
statement: Fix shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], rings A and B, a quasi-compact separated f:X→Spec A, g:Spec B→Spec A, a finite affine open cover U:Fin r→X.Opens with supremum top, and a quasi-coherent X-module G. Put p=pullback.fst f g and f′=pullback.snd f g. Assume additive tensor pullback along g and p. There exist a homotopy complex D, an augmentation a:G[0]→D and an isomorphism q:f_*D→the homotopy image of affineAlternatingCechModel f U G [def-pc-affine-alternating-cech-model], such that Qh(a) and Qh(p*(a)) are isomorphisms, the recorded right-derived units for f at D and f′ at p*D are isomorphisms, and Qh of termwise ordinary module base change at D is an isomorphism. Termwise exchange is the map of [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction], descended with the composition identifications; it has no left-derived counit or derived mate in its definition.

proof.text: Construct the increasing-tuple sheaf complex using open direct images on intersections, signed restrictions and augmentation. Inserting a cover index and sorting with sign gives a local contracting homotopy, including after ordinary pullback. Extend by zero to integer degrees. Apply affine_open_pushforward_rightAcyclic [lem-pc-affine-open-pushforward-acyclic] to each affine intersection factor. Right-acyclic objects are closed under finite products. The proved upstream criterion Functor.isIso_rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit_app_of_rightAcyclic makes the bounded-below unit invertible; Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility and its unit identity transport this to the unbounded unit. Apply these same statements to the pulled-back cover for the target unit. This uses their statements, not the all-tuples resolution construction. Identify f_*D with the explicit tilde section complex by the affine tilde-Gamma equivalence and its restriction formula.

An affine intersection inclusion j_J is affine because X is separated over the affine base: on any affine chart V its inverse image is the affine intersection U_J intersect V. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-affine-pushforward-base-change] to j_J, the cartesian pullback square along p, and the quasi-coherent restriction of G. This identifies pullback of each intersection pushforward with its pulled-back intersection pushforward. On each affine intersection ordinary exchange is the bijective section-pullback formula s tensor b ↦ b times p*s. Tensor commutes with finite products, and this formula commutes with every signed restriction; hence it gives an isomorphism of complexes and its localized exchange is invertible. If the cover is empty, X is empty and the zero complexes give the same conclusions.

theorem exists_affineAlternatingCech_exchange_resolution
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {A B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec A)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec A)
    {r : ℕ} (U : Fin r → X.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤)
    (haffine : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i))
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).Additive]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).Additive]
    (G : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G] :
    ∃ (D : HomotopyCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
      (a : (HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G ⟶ D)
      (q : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).mapHomotopyCategory
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D ≅
        (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          (affineAlternatingCechModel f U G)),
      IsIso (DerivedCategory.Qh.map a) ∧
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
        (moduleRings (pullback f g).toRingedSpace))).map
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).mapHomotopyCategory
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map a)) ∧
      IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app D) ∧
      IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
        (pullback.snd f g).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D)) ∧
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
        (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace))).map
        ((moduleHomotopyBaseChange f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
          pullback.condition).app D))
